description: Données Ouvertes sur les Châteaux d'Eau - Mini-AEP is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Les Châteaux d'eau - Mini-AEP (Adduction d'Eau Potable) font partie des infrastructures essentielles pour assurer l'approvisionnement en eau potable dans les zones rurales et périurbaines. Ces systèmes sont conçus pour desservir des populations de taille plus modeste, là où la mise en place de réseaux d'eau plus vastes n'est pas économiquement viable. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Its tags are chateau, eau. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
